<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X)/2 and the given molecular formula C16H27O3 (no N or halogens), the calculation is (2*16 + 2 - 27)/2 = (32 + 2 - 27)/2 = 7/2 = 3.5. Since DBE must be an integer, the nearest whole number is 4.</thought>
<final_answer>4</final_answer>
